name: Stockholm School of Economics in Riga
summary: Business school in Riga, partnered with the Stockholm School of Economics; one English-taught BSc, 150 places chosen by test and interview.

ib.text: Minimum 6 of 10 (or equivalent) in Maths and English; IB final exams can replace state exams, and predicted grades are accepted at application. Grades add no ranking points: test and interview decide.

programmes.name: Economics and Business
programmes.credential: BSc (Bachelor of Social Sciences in Economics)
programmes.about: A three-year, 195 ECTS degree taught entirely in English, with two paid summer internships and a choice of specialisation in the last year: economics, finance, entrepreneurship, data and AI, retail or international politics.
programmes.ib: Maths and English grades equal to 6 of 10; IB final exams can stand in for state exams; predicted grades are accepted at application, then the final transcript.

needs.note: Minimum 6 on a 10-point scale or equivalent; no IB conversion table is published
Minimum 6 of 10 or equivalent; B2 shown by an EU school certificate

programmes.selectionNote: Final score is 50% online admissions test (maths, logic, English) and 50% online interview; school grades add no points. 150 places.

notes: The full fee is 8,350 euro a year; EU, EEA and EFTA students automatically receive a 2,400 euro Baltic-EU scholarship, so they pay 5,950, fixed for all three years.
Applying is free, and up to 20 admissions scholarships are awarded on test and interview results with no separate application.
Applicants graduating in summer 2027 are admitted conditionally until the final secondary transcript and Maths and English results arrive.
